rationale: The stock is caught between conflicting forces: strong fundamental and session-long upward momentum (+31% from prior close on 7x relative volume, broad market up 1.86%) versus immediate short-term selling pressure (price has broken below the 5-minute 9-EMA at $63.67 and is printing accelerating bearish 1-minute candles on expanding volume). Furthermore, the bid-ask spread is wide at 38.4 bps ($0.24), creating significant friction right as price approaches a test of session VWAP ($61.81). With neither a confirmed bounce off VWAP for a long nor a clean breakdown below VWAP to justify shorting against a massive earnings catalyst and bullish market tape, skipping is the prudent choice.
